changelog: Smoothed the SOLDIER and Lucis backgrounds to remove visible bands and rectangular light transitions.
Refreshed l'Cie's background with a softer icy-blue vignette and changed its top header strip to navy.
Gave Standard's top header a muted teal color while keeping its tabs and buttons neutral.
Added depth to all theme headers and refined compact NS Flow branding.
Improved Merge Assistant headings, kept the Primary Record underline visible when zoomed out, and sized the Duplicate Record column to its longest name within the existing limit.
Shortened the Merge review note while retaining the permanent-merge warning and confirmation checkbox.
Expanded Current Territories to show up to six rows before scrolling and made the empty Territory Changes Summary compact.
Simplified the selected territory rep display to show the rep's name, vertical, tier, and sales sub region without a background box.
Hid empty selected-rep headings in ROE Checker and Sales Rep Search, displayed the selected rep's name in the heading, and made Extract theme-aware.
Made enabled Bulk Transfer options automatically select Target Record, Manager TAL with its default holdout date, and Out of Alignment.
Corrected footer spacing so content stays at the top, short pages use a 900px minimum height, and longer content pushes the footer down naturally.
